question: When does the level of universal non-difference become reflectively apprehended?
premises: The same process of later clarification applies here as well.
On the path of the rising of knowledge and related powers there is a level of universal non-difference.
That level becomes effective when it reaches reflective apprehension.
inference: Therefore the non-differentiated ground becomes manifest through reflective apprehension on the path of knowledge.
plain_english: So too here: afterward, on the path where knowledge and the other powers rise, the level consisting of universal non-difference comes to be reflectively apprehended.
